title: Special Topics in Computer Science; A Tour of Programming Languages
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in CMSC216, CMSC250 and CMSC330; and permission of CMNS-Computer Science department.

A Tour of Programming Languages introduces students to various programming paradigms and languages. This course aims to help students further their understanding of programming language (PL) design, as wellas gain experience with different programming philosophies, paradigms, and mindsets.
